psychological_meaning: Zambezi, a muted and earthy brown, evokes feelings of stability, reliability, and groundedness. It represents a connection to nature and a sense of calm practicality. Zambezi suggests dependability and a no-nonsense approach, often associated with resilience and a comforting presence.
